patch:
--- a/BOIDENT2.cbl
+++ b/BOIDENT2.cbl
@@ -31 +31 @@
-           IF WS-CAPITAL-PCT >= WS-BO-THRESHOLD
+           IF WS-CAPITAL-PCT > WS-BO-THRESHOLD
rationale: The capital criterion is strictly greater than 10 percent. Changing >= to > makes exactly 10 percent capital with no qualifying profit or control yield N while preserving the existing profit and control branches.
intended_behavior: Exactly 10 percent capital, zero profit, and no control yields N; strictly greater capital yields Y. Existing strict-profit and control branches remain unchanged.
